text:
anya: Quick idea — instead of forcing semver on all model pins, what if rollout metadata exposes a small set of compatibility bands (stable / compatible / fragile) plus a numeric priority? lightweight for clients to prefer without full version resolution.

kyle: I like the ergonomics. how would clients decide between two models in same band? weight or priority? :thinking_face:

harper: band + priority sounds ok but we need a deprecation signal too. mobile clients should be able to fall back if a model hits a hard grace window.

jess: sketching a minimal proposal:```json
{
  "model_id": "m-7b-qlora-v2",
  "compat_band": "compatible",
  "band_priority": 20,
  "deprecation_ts": "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z",
  "max_tokens_hint": 2048
}
```This keeps surface tiny and parsable.

anya: exactly, small and deterministic. clients prefer higher band_priority, but band ordering (stable>compatible>fragile) is authoritative. no full semver parsing required.

kyle: ops concern: control plane will need to enforce band transitions (e.g., compatible->fragile) and surface alerts. ops-bot can emit events when band changes.

ops-bot: Heads up — proposal registered as RFC-arch/compat-bands.ops (watch: #arch). Change events will be emitted to /events/model-band-change.

harper: edge-case — what about variants that are functionally compatible but differ in tokenization? band alone might be insufficient. propose an optional "compat_checks": ["tokenizer", "kv_cache"] field for validators.

jess: agreed, add a small array, default empty. it stays optional so majority of models remain tiny.

anya: next steps: (1) iterate small JSON schema with optional compat_checks and deprecation_ts, (2) add band-change webhook from control plane, (3) update client resolver heuristic (prefer band_priority then recency). happy to take (1).

kyle: i'll own (2). harper can you prototype client heuristic test harness?

harper: yep, will do a tiny simulation this week.

jess: leaving a note: avoid adding too many bands. 3 bands + priority covers most tradeoffs.

anya: cool — thanks everyone. will put a draft in the RFC folder by EOD. :thumbsup:
